While Debian repository items are being downloaded it is possible for compilation of other items to utilize the cpu. The majority of items outside of the Debian repository are just singular bash and python scripts. It's just a matter of locating all of them. Other items do require compilation.

This is a big endeavor and hopefully when it is done it will be possible to install all kali tools in any distribution with one command.
